title: Frozen contract: unified camera (v1)
description: Frozen at L0 per SPEC_RE_JOINTJS_PARITY.md §6 Lot 0. Source: spec/SPEC_RE_JOINTJS_PARITY.md §4.6 (lines 203-207). The contract camera is the diagram-canvas origin reading: camera.x/camera.y are the world point drawn at the view origin, camera.zoom is CSS pixels per world unit; view = (world - camera) * zoom (packages/diagram-canvas/src/transform.ts:178, cited at spec line 205). @sentropic/graph keeps its centre-based projection internally (packages/graph/src/mat4.ts:114) but receives the contract camera converted at the display-list boundary: centre = origin + viewport / (2 * zoom) per axis (spec line 207). No fixture may carry a raw JointJS tx/ty without that conversion. Same conversion as SPEC_RE_BPMN_JS_PARITY.md §5.7 and SPEC_RE_XYFLOW_PARITY.md §4 (viewport.x = -camera.x * camera.zoom).

x.description: World x at the view origin (origin reading).

y.description: World y at the view origin (origin reading).

zoom.description: CSS pixels per world unit; identical on both sides.

viewportWidth.description: CSS pixels; used only for the boundary conversion to the graph centre reading.
